entries.title: Jeremiah 9:1
segments: ¶Oh that my head were waters, and mine eyes a fountain of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people! {Oh...: Heb. Who will give my head, etc}

words.text: ! {Oh...: Heb. Who will give my head, etc}

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:2
segments: Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my people, and go from them! for they [be] all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.

words.text: from them! for they [be] all adulterers

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:3
segments: And they bend their tongues [like] their bow [for] lies: but they are not valiant for the truth upon the earth; for they proceed from evil to evil, and they know not me, saith the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:4
segments: Take ye heed every one of his neighbour, and trust ye not in any brother: for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbour will walk with slanders. {neighbour: or, friend}

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:5
segments: And they will deceive every one his neighbour, and will not speak the truth: they have taught their tongue to speak lies, [and] weary themselves to commit iniquity. {deceive: or, mock}

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:6
segments: Thine habitation [is] in the midst of deceit; through deceit they refuse to know me, saith the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:7
segments: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, Behold, I will melt them, and try them; for how shall I do for the daughter of my people?

words.text: them; for how shall I do

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:8
segments: Their tongue [is as] an arrow shot out; it speaketh deceit: [one] speaketh peaceably to his neighbour with his mouth, but in heart he layeth his wait. {in heart: Heb. in the midst of him} {his wait: or, wait for him}

words.text: . {in heart: Heb. in the midst of him} {his wait: or, wait for him}

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:9
segments: Shall I not visit them for these [things]? saith the LORD: shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:10
segments: For the mountains will I take up a weeping and wailing, and for the habitations of the wilderness a lamentation, because they are burned up, so that none can pass through [them]; neither can [men] hear the voice of the cattle; both the fowl of the heavens and the beast are fled; they are gone. {habitations: or, pastures} {burned up: or, desolate} {both...: Heb. from the fowl even to, etc}

words.text: . {habitations: or, pastures} {burned up: or, desolate} {both...: Heb. from the fowl even to, etc}

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:11
segments: And I will make Jerusalem heaps, [and] a den of dragons; and I will make the cities of Judah desolate, without an inhabitant. {desolate: Heb. desolation}

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:12
segments: ¶Who [is] the wise man, that may understand this? and [who is he] to whom the mouth of the LORD hath spoken, that he may declare it, for what the land perisheth [and] is burned up like a wilderness, that none passeth through?

words.text: this? and [who is he] to whom the mouth

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:13
segments: And the LORD saith, Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them, and have not obeyed my voice, neither walked therein;

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:14
segments: But have walked after the imagination of their own heart, and after Baalim, which their fathers taught them: {imagination: or, stubbornness}

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:15
segments: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will feed them, [even] this people, with wormwood, and give them water of gall to drink.

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:16
segments: I will scatter them also among the heathen, whom neither they nor their fathers have known: and I will send a sword after them, till I have consumed them.

words.text: , whom neither they nor their fathers

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:17
segments: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, Consider ye, and call for the mourning women, that they may come; and send for cunning [women], that they may come:

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:18
segments: And let them make haste, and take up a wailing for us, that our eyes may run down with tears, and our eyelids gush out with waters.

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:19
segments: For a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion, How are we spoiled! we are greatly confounded, because we have forsaken the land, because our dwellings have cast [us] out.

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:20
segments: Yet hear the word of the LORD, O ye women, and let your ear receive the word of his mouth, and teach your daughters wailing, and every one her neighbour lamentation.

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:21
segments: For death is come up into our windows, [and] is entered into our palaces, to cut off the children from without, [and] the young men from the streets.

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:22
segments: Speak, Thus saith the LORD, Even the carcases of men shall fall as dung upon the open field, and as the handful after the harvestman, and none shall gather [them].

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:23
segments: ¶Thus saith the LORD, Let not the wise [man] glory in his wisdom, neither let the mighty [man] glory in his might, let not the rich [man] glory in his riches:

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:24
segments: But let him that glorieth glory in this, that he understandeth and knoweth me, that I [am] the LORD which exercise lovingkindness, judgment, and righteousness, in the earth: for in these [things] I delight, saith the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:25
segments: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will punish all [them which are] circumcised with the uncircumcised; {punish: Heb. visit upon}

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:26
segments: Egypt, and Judah, and Edom, and the children of Ammon, and Moab, and all [that are] in the utmost corners, that dwell in the wilderness: for all [these] nations [are] uncircumcised, and all the house of Israel [are] uncircumcised in the heart. {in the utmost...: Heb. cut off into corners, or, having the corners of their hair polled}
